It actively pumps substrates from the intracellular space back into the lumen/blood, reducing oral absorption, brain penetration, and increasing renal and biliary clearance. Small molecular weight (< 300 Da) — compact molecules tend not to fill the large binding cavity effectively. Few aromatic rings (0-1).
